subject: MAP: POC environment — final-mile checklist for org/APIs/IPs/VPC peering
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@heliosai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment — final-mile checklist for org/APIs/IPs/VPC peering

Hi Nina —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a concise mutual action plan (MAP-HeliosAI-v3.xlsx) that consolidates the environment-setup tasks we agreed are must-haves to get your POC running on a production-like footprint. High level items we have for the next two weeks: 

- Org & tenant creation: Redwood will provision HeliosAI tenant and seed initial service accounts.
- API keys & rotation: we'll generate scoped API keys for your dev/staging team and propose an ephemeral rotation cadence.
- IP allowlist: HeliosAI to provide public egress IPs for your test harness; we provide suggested CIDR format CSV.
- VPC peering: if you want private routing, we can set up VPC peering (Redwood side guidance attached).
- Security questionnaire handoff: procurement asked for an SSP snippet — we can deliver within 48h.

I put tentative owners in the attached sheet, but quick notes here: Priyom will run the actual tenant/API provisioning and hand over API keys to your dev lead; Marissa will coordinate procurement and any contract-level gating items.

Requested timeline: we aim to have API keys, org seed, and IP allowlist validated by EOD Friday (2026-05-22) so you can run a 48h smoke run the following week. If VPC peering is required, that will add 3 business days after we have your peering CIDR and consolidation approvals.

Next actions: can you confirm who on your side will be the network owner (name + email) and whether procurement prefers DocuSign or a PDF redline process?

Thanks,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
From: Nina Patel <nina@heliosai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@heliosai.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment — final-mile checklist for org/APIs/IPs/VPC peering

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan and the workbook, that helps a lot. A few clarifying points from our side: 

1) Network owner: that's me for the initial POC (Nina Patel, nina@heliosai.com). I will loop in our infra lead if/when we go to VPC peering.
2) IPs: attaching a small CSV of the current test harness egresss (see attachment). We may add a couple more ranges later.
3) Procurement: we prefer DocuSign for the SOW + standard MSA redline. I'll have procure@heliosai.com send an order form if needed.

One ask: can you confirm what data is persisted by Redwood during the POC (retention window, logs, KV cache behavior)? Our security folks will want an explicit retention line item to match policy.

I can commit to reviewing the MAP worksheet by EOD Wednesday.

Nina

--
Nina Patel
Head of Platform, HeliosAI
nina@heliosai.com
Attachment: helios-egress-ips.csv (attachment stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@heliosai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment — final-mile checklist for org/APIs/IPs/VPC peering

Thanks, Nina — quick answers and owner matrix below. Quoting the previous note for context.

On data retention: Redwood's hosted POC default retention is 30 days for request/response logs and 90 days for metric aggregates unless you request a different retention window on the contract. We do not persist full user input in long-term storage by default; KV cache is ephemeral and tied to the runtime instance, purged on instance recycle. Detailed SSP snippet is attached (redwood-ssp-poc-snippet.pdf).

Owner matrix (as mapped in MAP-HeliosAI-v3.xlsx):
- Tenant/Org seed: Priyom Das (priyom@redwood.com) — will create HeliosAI tenant, set basic RBAC, and invite dev users.
- API key generation: Priyom (dev/staging keys) + HeliosAI dev lead (consent to key handoff).
- IP allowlist validation: Nina (nina@heliosai.com) to confirm ranges; Karthik will validate connectivity tests.
- VPC peering coordination: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.com) will own the procurement/ops dialogue and will loop our cloud infra team for peering configuration.

VPC peering note: if you want to do peering, please confirm the following from your side: VPC ID, CIDR block (no overlap), preferred routing flavor (static routes or managed route tables), and whether you require private DNS. Once we have that, we estimate 2-3 business days to complete the peering handshake and validate connectivity on both sides.

Attachments in this email: redwood-ssp-poc-snippet.pdf, network-allowlist-template.csv, MAP-HeliosAI-v3.xlsx

Next steps I will take this afternoon: create the tenant and seed the first API keys scoped to the test harness, then share the ephemeral keys via our secure key transfer link. Expect that by EOD today (2026-05-20).

Thanks —
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Platform Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
From: Nina Patel <nina@heliosai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment — final-mile checklist for org/APIs/IPs/VPC peering

Team —

All good on our side. Confirming:
- We received the tenant invite and the dev API key via the secure link (works fine).
- IPs in helios-egress-ips.csv validated against your template and allowed traffic to the /health endpoint.
- Procurement will start the DocuSign flow today for the scoped PO; procure@heliosai.com will be the signer.
- We are deferring VPC peering for the initial smoke run; will re-open if we need private routing after the first week.

Target: we will run the 48h smoke test Monday-Tuesday next week (2026-05-25 to 2026-05-26). If that is successful, we should be ready to discuss a short-term Dedicated evaluation for predictable throughput.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the templated MAP, that sped things up.

Nina
--
Nina Patel
Head of Platform, HeliosAI
nina@heliosai.com
